title: Gold Saver Account: Business Credit Card APY Bonuses
summary: This document explains Gold Saver Account APY bonuses when you hold an eligible Rho Business Rewards Card: +0.2% (Business Silver), +0.4% (Business Gold), or +0.6% (Business Platinum), added as percentage points to your base Gold Saver APY and used to calculate interest. It also covers how eligibility changes update your APY and how to confirm the bonus in your Gold Saver Account details.
